massing_review.observed: Six-plus-nine upper window rhythm and terminal bay match composition. Main hip and two rear volumes distinguish the range. Rear wing initially too wide against roof image and shared block boundary; reduced from 7 to 5 m before detailing. Front render was poorly lit; adjusted illumination, not materials, for review.
massing_review.remaining: Rear openings are approximate photogrammetric reconstructions. Street registration retained to avoid an unverified unilateral neighbour move.

comparisons: Front render and Detail/Walk exports preserve six-plus-nine rhythm, separate terminal bay, recessed shops and projecting cornice against frontal photographs. Carved foliage remains an approximation, signage is readable authored typography rather than a traced logo.
District front retains facade composition and roof silhouette in 84 triangles; relief, window depth and lettering are baked into shared atlases.
Assembled front joins Occulo and reserved Empire placeholder without retaining a placeholder through the new footprint. Rear wing/court reservation preserves the gap between extensions.

Rear oblique comparison showed the four-column pale window range belongs on the long courtyard-facing wing side, not its outer gable. Corrected before completion; low brick wing openings likewise face the court.
limits: No ground-level rear photography; window sizes and finishes remain provisional.
Neighbour registration discrepancy is recorded in coverage.json; no unilateral neighbour move.
Empire and the rest of the west Lord Street block remain placeholders. Private yard ground and inaccessible party elevations are deferred.
